title: STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning
authors: E. Zelikman, Y. Wu, J. Mu, N. Goodman
before: Reasoning was prompted at inference; training on reasoning needed human-written rationales.
problem: Nobody can write rationales for every problem a model should learn to solve.
breakthrough: Let the model generate its own rationales, keep the ones that reach the right answer, and fine-tune on those.
why: Self-generated reasoning data, verified by outcome, is the core loop that RL-trained reasoning models later industrialised.
next: Process supervision, then the RL reasoning training in o1 and DeepSeek-R1.
inherits: Training on a model's own verified reasoning.
